meta.beschrijving: Magical parties in a fairytale setting in Amsterdam and surroundings. Small girls' parties at home, a flower experience for highly sensitive children and mother and daughter moments in the studio.

hero.ondertitel: The magic that stays, long after the paint is gone
hero.tekst: I let children experience themselves as magic, at small parties with a fairytale atmosphere. Calm and with all the time in the world: a handful of friends at a birthday, a mother and daughter together, or a child who feels a lot and for that very reason sits still the longest.
hero.instagramTekst: See my work and the atmosphere on Instagram

tekst: An afternoon of learning to paint on skin. You start with a single line and by the end there is a flower on your neighbour's arm.
I show you how paint behaves on skin, how to work with two colours at once and where to place glitter and gems so the light finds them.
All materials are ready for you. Come with empty hands and zero experience, just a willingness to get them dirty.
evenement.prijsToelichting: materials, tea and something sweet included
evenement.wachtlijst: Add me to the waiting list

aanbod.intro: Small, magical parties in a fairytale setting, with up to eight children in an hour and a half. A children's party of an hour and a half costs 110 euro and my hourly rate starts at 60 euro. If I come to your home, only possible public transport travel costs are added. I am not available for drop-in parties or large, fast jobs.

items.kort: An atmospheric party of an hour and a half at your home, for up to eight children. Each child is painted one by one in La Flora's fairytale style.
items.vanaf: 110 euro, excl. possible public transport travel costs
items.voor: Small girls' parties, up to eight children
beschrijving: A small, atmospheric party at your home, in a magical fairytale setting. In an hour and a half I paint up to eight children, one by one, in La Flora's own style: flowers, lines and glitter, tuned to each child.

I work in a separate, quiet room. The child in the chair and one child who may watch, while the others are calmly brought and collected. That way each child gets my full attention and a moment of her own at the mirror.
If there is time left, the Rose Glitter Bar opens: skin jewels and glitter that make the party complete.
praktisch: Up to eight children in an hour and a half
A separate, quiet room and someone who brings and collects the children one by one
This party comes with my fixed way of working, which you can read on the homepage under Does my way of working suit your party?
I come for small parties. I am not available for drop-in parties or large, fast jobs

items.naam: Flower experience for highly sensitive children
items.kort: A calm, slowed-down face painting experience of an hour and a half at your home, for one to three children. With a little case to explore and all the time in the world.
items.vanaf: 110 euro, excl. possible public transport travel costs
items.voor: Highly sensitive children, up to three
beschrijving: For children who are quickly overwhelmed at a busy party and still long to feel magic on their birthday. I come to you and turn the kitchen table into a place where everything revolves around her.

We start by getting to know each other. I bring a small case that the children may open and explore themselves. They can tell me what they find beautiful and what they have experienced with face paint before.
Then I paint them one by one while the others watch. Calm, quiet and time are at the heart of it. A scent and taste moment with orange makes the experience even richer, a memory you can smell.
If there is time left, I bring out the Rose Glitter Bar, for example for the guests who come to the birthday.
praktisch: An hour and a half at your home, in a familiar and safe setting
For one to three children, so each child gets my full attention
At the kitchen table in a tidy room. The quieter the room, the deeper the children go into it
During the experience all my attention is with the children. Afterwards I love to hear your reactions and questions

items.kort: An hour and a half together in my studio, all about connection. With her mother, grandmother, aunt, big sister or another special woman in her life.
items.voor: A child together with a special woman in her life
beschrijving: A special experience in my studio, for the two of you together. With her mother, or with a grandmother, aunt, big sister or another woman who means a lot to her.
Depending on her age I give a small workshop in which you make flowers together. For young children there is a fitting alternative, such as a colouring page.
In a separate room stands the magic mirror. There is all the space there to look, experience and connect together.
praktisch: An hour and a half in my studio
Together with a mother, grandmother, aunt, big sister or another special woman

items.kort: A creative workshop for up to six participants, especially for teenagers. First practising on a board, then on each other or on your own arm.
items.vanaf: 110 euro, excl. possible public transport travel costs
items.voor: Especially teenagers, up to six participants
beschrijving: A creative workshop for a small group. You learn to paint a little flower, first on a practice board and then on each other or on your own arm.
I also teach you a few simple skin jewels, so you could sell them yourself on King's Day, for example.
If the workshop is part of a birthday or another celebration, we can extend it with extra flowers.
All materials are ready. You can come empty-handed and with zero experience.
praktisch: All materials are ready, no experience needed
Can be extended with extra flowers for a birthday or celebration

items.kort: Your pregnant belly as a flower garden, painted in about an hour. Calm, at your home, with photos to remember it by.
items.vanaf: from 95 euro, excl. possible public transport travel costs
beschrijving: We start with a cup of tea and a conversation about what you love. Flowers, vines, stars, or something that only means something to you.
Then I paint straight onto your belly with skin friendly paint. You lie or sit comfortably, and you are welcome to fall asleep.
We finish with photos, so you keep this belly forever. The paint rinses off in the shower.
praktisch: Wear something paint is welcome on

items.kort: Skin jewels, roses and glitter. Part of my parties now, and in the future perhaps also bookable on its own for larger parties.
items.duur: in the time left over at a party
items.voor: Guests at a girls' party or birthday
beschrijving: The Rose Glitter Bar is a table full of skin jewels, little roses and glitter. I almost always use it to fill the remaining time creatively, at a girls' party or at the birthday of a highly sensitive child.
In the future you will be able to book the Rose Glitter Bar as a separate service for larger parties. For now it is part of my parties and cannot yet be booked separately.
praktisch: Part of the girls' party and the flower experience
In the future perhaps also bookable on its own

stappen.tekst: Tell me about the day, the place and who it is for. I work with small groups in a calm place; together we look at whether that fits. I let you know within two days whether I am free.
You tell me about the day, about the child and about what she loves. I involve the child in the design. It arises in the moment, in my own style, and grows from the very first line.
The moment it is all about: she looks, she goes quiet, and she sees herself exactly as she is.
The paint comes off with water and soap. What remains is the memory of an afternoon that revolved entirely around her.

voorwie.intro: La Flora is for you if you recognise something here.
punten: You love flowers, leaves, vines and things that glitter.
Your child feels a lot, and you want someone who asks before she touches.
You are looking for a moment that revolves entirely around her, not around the clock.
You find calm and attention more important than speed and numbers.
You deliberately choose a small party rather than a big event.

items.antwoord: Flowers, in every kind. Roses, lotuses, small wild flowers, leaves and vines, with glitter and gems where the light falls. Sometimes a butterfly or a star in between. Everything that is soft, light and organic. That is my handwriting and it is what I am best at.

items.vraag: My child wants a spider or a dragon. Is that possible?
items.antwoord: With me everything becomes a flower. A spider becomes a star flower with eight petals, a dragon a vine of fire-coloured flowers along the arm. She chooses the idea, I translate it into my language. For tough animals and monsters as you know them from the fairground a classic children's face painter is the better choice; that way everyone does their own thing.
From around four years old. The flower painting workshop is especially for teenagers, and at the mother and daughter experience an adult joins in.

A children's party of an hour and a half costs 110 euro, belly painting starts at 95 euro and my hourly rate starts at 60 euro. If I come to your home, only possible public transport travel costs are added.

items.vraag: Can you come to a large party or event?
items.antwoord: I only work at small parties, with up to eight children in an hour and a half. I am not available for drop-in parties, events or large groups. An all-round face painter will suit you better for those.
Up to eight at a girls' party, one to three at the flower experience and up to six at the workshop. Always in an hour and a half or less, so every child has all the time in the world at the mirror.
At your home. The mother and daughter experience takes place in my studio. I bring everything: paint, glitter, a mirror and light.

items.vraag: How long does it stay on?
items.antwoord: A day, sometimes two. With water and soap it comes right off. The memory stays.

I work with professional, skin-friendly face paint and cosmetic glitter, and hygiene matters to me. Still, every skin reacts differently. If your child has sensitive skin or an allergy, please let me know in advance. Parents remain responsible for any skin reactions; I cannot be held liable for them.

items.vraag: Can I give it as a gift?
items.antwoord: Yes, a session makes a lovely gift for a birthday, a baby shower or just because. Send me a message and I will turn it into a gift voucher.

tekst: I am Jasmina, an artist with a love for flowers, lines and glitter. I paint slowly. First you feel the brush on your hand, only then on your face. I say what I am about to do before I do it, and we stop the moment you want to. That is why I work small, so that I can really see every child.

For children who feel a lot, that makes all the difference. All the time in the world, gentle hands, and someone who asks before she touches. Parents of highly sensitive children know how rare that is, and those children often sit still the longest.
I work from experience. My work is built with care, driven by a love of detail and feeling. What I bring is paint, glitter, a mirror and the calm to really take my time. At your home or in my studio.

passend.titel: Is my way of working a good fit for your party?
passend.intro: When you book me, you are choosing a personal experience and a little fairytale magic. My speciality is detailed floral and line work, and I practise it every single day to keep refining my technique. I'm proud of where my work is today, and I keep practising because I love to grow and lift it to a higher level each time.

onderdelen.kop: You're choosing a work of art, not an entertainer
onderdelen.tekst: You may be used to a face painter copying whatever is asked for, with you as the client deciding what happens. Within my concept, things work in a fundamentally different way. You are not hiring an entertainer to follow instructions. You are choosing me as an independent artist, and my work as something truly exclusive.

punten.tekst: You are choosing my own style, signature and expertise. Nothing is fixed in advance; I decide on the brush and line work in the moment.
My floral and line work grows from within. I look at the child in my chair and let the colours and shapes follow their unique expressions and sparkle.
It is precisely by leaving the reins entirely to me that the serene fairytale atmosphere and refined elegance my work is known for can unfold.

onderdelen.kop: How I work at your party
onderdelen.tekst: After 25 years of working with children, I bring more than just my brushes. I bring a natural calm and a real feel for the way children experience the world. To make sure every child gets that personal attention and care, I work with a set approach:

punten.tekst: I work best in a separate, quiet room. It gives me the focus I need for fine brushwork, and that is exactly what makes room for real, cosy, personal moments with each child in my chair.
There is room for two children at a time: the one in the chair and one who gets to watch. Those moments of watching build a lovely sense of anticipation for their own transformation.

punten.kop: A helping hand from the host:
punten.tekst: So I can keep my full attention on the child in the chair, the host or organiser makes sure the children are calmly brought in and picked up, one at a time.
To give every design and every child the care they deserve, I paint a maximum of 8 children per 1.5 hours.
I absolutely love hearing what you think of my work! Feel free to save it until I'm done. While I'm painting, I like to keep my attention fully on the child in the chair.

slot: I am not available for drop-in parties, events or large, fast jobs. I am not an all-round face painter who paints a big group of children at speed in the middle of the party buzz. Is that what you are looking for, or would you rather decide for yourself what gets painted? Then an all-round fellow face painter will suit you better, and I will happily point you in the right direction.
Are you choosing calm, personal attention and craftsmanship, and do you fully trust my style and vision? Then I would love to create something truly exceptional for your party.

projecten.tekst: Do you have a project in mind that falls outside my parties, such as a photo shoot or a creative collaboration? Feel free to get in touch and we will look together at what is possible. My rate for projects starts at 60 euro per hour.

boeken.tekst: Send a message with the date, the place and what you have in mind. A small group, a calm place, all the time in the world: that is what I am best at. I reply within two days.

voorwaarden.beschrijving: The terms that apply to a session, party or workshop with La Flora Body Art.
voorwaarden.intro: These terms apply to all sessions, parties, workshops and projects by La Flora Body Art (Chamber of Commerce 68314752). By making an appointment you agree to these terms. In case of any difference, the Dutch version applies.

tekst: Your booking is final once payment has been received. You will receive a confirmation in advance by email or message, stating the date, the location, the duration, the number of participants and the price.
My parties are small: no more than eight children in an hour and a half. If more children come than agreed, I may adjust the programme accordingly.
Prices are listed on the website and in the confirmation. If I come to your home, any travel costs by public transport are added.
You pay the agreed amount in advance, in the way and within the term stated in the confirmation or on the invoice. Paying afterwards is not possible.
If extra costs arise on the day itself, such as travel costs or extra time, I will send a separate invoice for them afterwards.
Please reschedule or cancel in writing, by email or message, and as soon as possible. We will then look for a new date together.
If I am ill or unable to come myself, I will let you know as soon as possible and suggest a new date.
I work with professional, skin-friendly face paint and cosmetic glitter, and hygiene matters to me. I clean my materials and disinfect them where needed.
Please provide a clean, quiet place to work, with a table and access to clean water.
Every skin reacts differently. Even with professional and skin-friendly materials, a skin reaction or allergic reaction cannot be ruled out.
If your child has sensitive skin, an allergy, a skin condition or has reacted to face paint before, please let me know in advance. If in doubt, consult a doctor first.
Parents or guardians remain responsible for any skin reactions and allergic reactions. La Flora Body Art cannot be held liable for them.

Remove the paint the same day with cold water and soap, without hard rubbing. Do not use lukewarm or warm water: it makes the colour sink into the skin. Do not leave the paint on overnight. If you notice redness, itching or swelling, remove the paint straight away and contact a doctor if in doubt.

I do not paint on skin with wounds, a rash, eczema, an inflammation or a cold sore, or with a contagious condition such as chickenpox or head lice. I also do not paint a child who is ill. Where possible, the child and I choose another spot together, such as the hand or the arm.
I never paint a child who does not want it. I always ask first whether I may begin.
I provide the creative session, not childcare. Parents or guardians remain responsible for the children before, during and after the session.
Face paint and glitter can rub off on clothing and furniture. I work carefully, but I am not liable for stains or damage to clothing, furniture or belongings.
La Flora Body Art is not liable for damage caused by information about a participant's skin or health not being shared, or being shared incompletely.
Should La Flora Body Art nevertheless be liable, that liability is limited to the amount paid for the appointment concerned. Liability that cannot be excluded by law remains.
I never take photos of children. I want to be reliable in that: no pictures of your child end up with me.
I do love it when parents send me photos that I may use on my website and social media. I only do so with your permission, and you can withdraw it at any time.
Dutch law applies to these terms and all appointments. If you have a question or complaint, email me at jasminaswonderland@gmail.com. Together we will always work it out.
